raw_module_count_limit: Initial literal owner-map entries are not the same measure as reviewed source families; they are not acceptance or installation counts.
scope: Byte-exact historical source/evidence mirror only. Original script/review/catalog paths are not installed; no source application, active screening, runtime, asset, pin, authority or gameplay change.
